task.description: WF-02 step 02e (ORCH): infrastructure action for the login-directory pepper

result.summary: INFRASTRUCTURE ACTION required on every host that runs a build containing PR #2201, BEFORE the merge to main triggers QA's redeploy (QA redeploys on every merge; config/runtime.exs refuses to boot in EVERY environment without these, so a host without them will not start). (1) Generate the pepper with `openssl rand -hex 32`: exactly 64 lowercase hex characters, NOT all zeros, NOT all f, and DIFFERENT from LETFLOW_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY. (2) Choose a key id matching [a-z0-9_-]{1,32} (for example p2026a); it is stored on every directory row and must NEVER be reused for a different pepper. (3) Put both in the host's deploy/.env (the env_file next to docker-compose.qa.yml, template deploy/.env.example): LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER=<64 hex> and LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_ID=<id>. Never commit, log, paste into a ticket or hand off the value. (4) LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_PREVIOUS and LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_PREVIOUS_ID are for rotation only: set BOTH or NEITHER, previous must differ from current (value and id); leave blank in steady state. (5) The migration (public table tenant_login_directory with key_id) runs with the deploy. A developer database that already ran the earlier version of migration 20261004000001 needs `mix ecto.rollback --step 1` then `mix ecto.migrate`. (6) After the deploy run the backfill, dry run first, then for real, in a maintenance window (insert-only, no lock): without it existing users are undiscoverable. Mix form (dev/CI): `mix letflow.backfill_login_directory --dry-run` then `mix letflow.backfill_login_directory`. RELEASE FORM (a deployed release container has NO Mix; verified on QA by infra T-0154): put the one-line expression in expr.exs and feed it via STDIN, never inline: ssh <host> "docker exec -i letflow-qa-app-1 sh -c 'timeout 300 bin/letflow rpc \"$(cat)\"'" < expr.exs 2>expr.err (default exec user/workdir, run as bin/letflow exactly, timeout 300 as a hang guard, stderr kept separate: harmless ESOCK/libsctp warning at rpc start; smoke check first: docker exec letflow-qa-app-1 sh -c 'bin/letflow rpc "IO.puts(Code.ensure_loaded?(Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill))"' prints true). Each expression is ONE line that prints its own result with IO.puts; pass/fail = a SUMMARY line present (backfill: also failed=0), NOT the exit status. Output is key ids/tenant ids/counts/atoms only, never an email or secret. The exact expressions for backfill dry/real, key_status and retire_key dry/real are in docs/runbooks/login-directory-pepper-rotation.md section 0. BACKFILL expression (dry run; for real use Backfill.run()): case Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill.run(dry_run: true) do {:ok, r} -> Enum.each(r.tenants, fn t -> IO.puts("tenant #{t.tenant_id}: users_read=#{t.users_read} keys=#{t.keys} inserted=#{t.inserted}") end); Enum.each(r.failed, fn f -> IO.puts("tenant #{f.tenant_id}: FAILED reason=#{f.reason}") end); IO.puts("SUMMARY dry_run=#{r.dry_run} tenants=#{length(r.tenants)} failed=#{length(r.failed)} inserted=#{Enum.sum(Enum.map(r.tenants, & &1.inserted))} key_id=#{r.key_id}"); {:error, e} -> IO.puts("ERROR #{inspect(e)}") end The same call is the re-keying step after a pepper rotation. (7) Do NOT enable LETFLOW_LOGIN_DISCOVERY_ENABLED outside dev: 0042 OQ-3 (lawful basis and controller) is unresolved and gates enabling. (8) EXTERNAL: ai-dala-infra's landscape/secrets-inventory.md needs an entry for LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER and LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_ID per environment (QA, production), owner and rotation procedure; that repository is not edited from here. Rotation tooling (retire_key, key_status, runbook) is REQ-443, not yet built.
